message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card over to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied after each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard. 3. If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | **Wild Draw Four Challenge** | If a player believes the previous player could have played a card of the same color instead of a Wild Draw Four, they may challenge.
• If the challenger is correct (the previous player had a matching color card), the challenger draws four cards.
• If the challenger is wrong, they draw six cards. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. If the winner reaches or exceeds the target (e.g., 500), the game ends. Otherwise, start a new round with a fresh shuffle. | | **Optional House Rules** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other.
• **No Wild Draw Four** – remove those cards entirely.
• **Higher Score Target** – set a different point goal. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Deal** 7 cards each. 2. **Start** with the top card of the discard pile. 3. **Play** a matching card or draw. 4. **Use** action cards to affect the next player. 5. **Call UNO** when you’re down to one card. 6. **Finish** the round when someone goes out. 7. **Score** and repeat until the target is reached. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
